Title

Winter Clothing Store Header - Brrr

Description

Winter clothing store hero header with a 3D clothes rail built in Three.js. A colour-cycling loader opens onto twelve soft puffers, knits and coats that swing on a pipe rack, turn to face you on hover and zoom in on scroll. Built in React.
